通用 API 融入专业模式，三角色独立搭配渠道并在模型弹框中配置；新增百灵、Lo: Custom APIs now live in professional mode, with independent channels and in-dialog configuration for each role. Adds Ant Ling, LongCat 2.5 vision and Novita Ming image generation.
可选能力受协议、地区及账号权限限制；目录与代码已适配，新增渠道的真实模型调用尚未: Available capabilities depend on the protocol, region and account. Catalog and code integration are complete; live inference through the new channels has not been verified.
保留普通与专业两种模式，将通用 API 放入主模型、识图和生图的渠道列表，支持与: Keep normal and professional modes, and offer custom APIs in the main, vision and image channel lists so each role can use a different provider.
通用 API 固定排在渠道列表首位；首次使用仍默认观猹 TokenDance，已: Custom API appears first in each channel list. New users still default to Watcha TokenDance, while returning users retain their saved choices.
在模型选择弹框内编辑协议、地址、密钥和型号，获取模型或手动填写 ID；外层设置只: Edit the protocol, endpoint, key and model inside the model picker. Fetch models or enter an ID manually; the settings panel shows a summary and edit entry.
区分尚未获取、获取失败与没有适用模型；切换渠道和关闭弹框保留各角色草稿，沿用密钥: Distinguish models not yet fetched, fetch failures and no matching models. Preserve role drafts when changing channels or closing the dialog, with existing key storage rules.
新增蚂蚁百灵文本与视觉型号，并将 LongCat-2.5-Preview 接入现: Add Ant Ling text and vision models and LongCat-2.5-Preview to the existing vision workflow, while preserving historical models and defaults.
新增独立 Novita 渠道的 Ming 文生图，使用单独账号与密钥，并按接口校: Add Ming text-to-image through the independent Novita channel, using separate credentials and API-specific size, format and capability validation.
专业模式、通用 API 与任务恢复升级: Professional mode, Universal API and task recovery
三角色独立搭配渠道，完善通用 API 配置、连接复用、思考设置和任务恢复；扩展已: Combine providers independently for three model roles, with improved Universal API setup, reusable connections, thinking settings and task recovery, plus audited image tools and cloud model interfaces.
通用 API 增加连接模板，按角色和实际能力渐进展示配置；参考图识别模型统一称为: Add connection templates and progressive, capability-aware Universal API settings. Rename the reference recognition role to Vision model while preserving independent role settings and historical selections.
提供命名连接和不含密钥的配置文件导入、导出；应用前预览影响范围，连接与密钥分别显: Add named connections and key-free configuration import and export, with an impact preview and separate explicit actions for copying connection settings and credentials.
协议切换保留自定义地址和历史草稿，明确密钥解绑原因；区分当前页修改与浏览器保存，: Preserve custom addresses and drafts when switching protocols, explain credential unbinding, distinguish page edits from browser saves, and report storage errors or conflicting edits from another tab.
分别展示配置、地址、目录与真实调用状态；目录失败、为空或不完整时保留手填型号，并: Show separate configuration, address, catalog and real-call states. Preserve manual model entry for failed, empty or partial catalogs, with recovery guidance and visual size choices.
展示可信目录元数据及来源，区分服务方限制、平台硬上限和用户限制；旧配置保留原有约: Show trusted catalog metadata and its sources. Separate provider, platform and user limits, preserving legacy constraints without treating unknown limits as unlimited.
通用 API 接入现有思考参数体系，按精确连接、协议、型号和角色提供已适配控件；: Integrate Universal API routes with existing thinking controls, scoped to the exact connection, protocol, model and role. Provider default omits extra fields, and task recovery preserves the original settings.
在 Responses 协议内支持 OpenAI 与 xAI 已确认的图像工具，: Support audited OpenAI and xAI image tools within Responses, separating the caller from the image model and reusing generation, image-input refinement and supported reference workflows.
增加 Azure OpenAI v1 部署连接，以及 Amazon Bedroc: Add Azure OpenAI v1 deployment connections, Amazon Bedrock Converse and model-specific InvokeModel image interfaces, validated against region, deployment, credential expiry and model rules.
已登录生成与精修任务在确认接收前保存恢复资料，服务中断后可主动恢复同一任务；任务: Persist recovery data before accepting signed-in generation and refinement tasks. Resume the same task after an interruption or reopen its progress from history, without automatically resending calls with unknown outcomes.
完善异步渠道原任务查询与产物下载恢复：保存上游任务号，单次查询超时不直接判失败，: Improve asynchronous task polling and artifact download recovery: persist upstream task IDs, avoid declaring failure after a single polling timeout, and reuse saved results or query the original task when downloads fail.
通用 API 与任务恢复补充实现: Universal API and task recovery supplement
登录后同步工作区与模型库；多个标签页及两个站点之间自动同步任务内容，冲突时保留双: Signed-in workspaces and model libraries sync across tabs and both sites. Conflicting edits retain both versions in a separate copy, while each page keeps its own viewing position.
统一上传图片、PDF、PPTX、DOCX、XLSX、CSV、TSV、JSON、T: Upload images, PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TSV, JSON, TXT and Markdown source material in one place. Generation accepts up to 10 files of up to 10 MB each; the source image for refinement is counted separately.
模型可按绘图需要查找原文、表格和 PDF／PPTX 页面，并保留材料读取记录；缺: Models can look up source text, tables and PDF/PPTX pages as needed, with a record of material reads. Missing data, read failures and unsupported formats are reported explicitly.
“优化输入”支持结合已上传附件整理绘图要求，仅有附件时也可发起；确认采用后再写回: Optimize input can use uploaded attachments to organize drawing requirements, even without typed text. Apply the result explicitly to update the current draft.
新增期刊规则库，覆盖 Nature、Scientific Reports、Cel: A journal rules library covers Nature, Scientific Reports, Cell Reports and humanities and social science journals. View dimensions, formats, fonts, AI policies and official sources for the selected submission stage and figure purpose.
新增“我的模型”管理，按渠道、厂商和型号选择已添加模型；TokenDance 授: Manage My Models and choose added models by provider, developer and model. After TokenDance authorization, available models from its returned catalog are added automatically.
全局搜索覆盖任务、功能与工具，支持名称、别名和关键词；可直达模型、期刊、账户设置: Global search covers tasks, features and tools by name, alias and keyword. Jump to models, journals, account settings and research tools; selecting a result only opens its destination.
接入他山科研生态：Semiotic 图表、VizNoir 科学网格可视化与 Da: The Tashan research tools add Semiotic charts, VizNoir scientific mesh visualization and DataViz interactive dashboards, with rendering and SVG, PNG or offline HTML downloads. Tool rendering does not require model calls.
精修和 SVG 修改保留原图对应的材料、图型及期刊设置；切换原图时清除不再适用的: Refinement and SVG revision retain the source image’s materials, figure type and journal settings. Changing the source clears decisions that no longer apply, preventing settings from another image from carrying over.
模型目录持续更新，补充精确渠道型号、生命周期和规格来源，区分渠道能力与原厂参考；: Update exact provider model IDs, lifecycle information and specification sources, distinguishing provider capabilities from original developer references. Retired models show a reason and cannot be selected; saved choices are not silently replaced.
整理模型配置与思考设置，只显示当前角色和型号已核实的可调项；目录刷新、搜索与详情: Streamline model configuration and thinking controls to show verified adjustable settings for the current role and model. Catalog refresh, search and detail views preserve existing selections and drafts.
移动端采用可收起输入区、普通／专业模式滑块、独立上传按钮与抽屉侧栏；完善键盘避让: Mobile layouts add a collapsible composer, a basic/professional mode switch, a dedicated upload button and a sidebar drawer, with improved keyboard handling, long-text entry and dialog transitions.
修复多标签或断网重连时保存被阻断、迟到结果干扰当前任务的问题；生成中可继续编辑下: Fix blocked saves across tabs or after reconnecting, and late results interfering with the current task. Edit the next draft while a run is active, and avoid duplicate history entries for the same run.
修复打开搜索导致侧栏退出及结果数量变化引起的弹窗跳动；取消搜索保留侧栏滚动位置，: Fix the sidebar closing when search opens and the dialog jumping as result counts change. Canceling search retains sidebar scroll position, and selecting the same tool again navigates correctly.
修复普通 PNG 使用默认清晰度时提交无效尺寸的问题，保留模型支持的默认比例与明: Fix invalid dimensions being submitted for PNG generation at default resolution, preserving supported default aspect ratios and explicitly selected sizes.
修复旧 SVG 草稿覆盖历史原件、保存后残留草稿及版本串写问题；历史原件保持不变: Fix stale SVG drafts overwriting historical originals, drafts remaining after save and edits leaking between versions. Historical originals remain unchanged, and draft recovery requires an explicit action.
修复账户绘制活动读取失败、执行耗时字段显示不全及已有结果未选中时仍显示等待的问题: Fix drawing activity retrieval failures, missing execution durations and waiting messages shown when results already exist but are not selected, keeping statistics and progress aligned with actual results.
搜索、任务删除与科研生态联合发布: Search, task deletion and research tools release
账户、生成过程与移动端发布: Account, generation progress and mobile release
新版 UI、生成工作流与模型路由升级: A new UI, generation workflow and model routing
新版 UI：重构为左侧任务导航、中央大画布与底部输入区，整合模型、绘图设置和账户: New UI: a task sidebar, large central canvas and bottom composer bring model, drawing and account controls together. PNG and SVG retain separate drafts, settings and result versions.
生成工作流重构：主模型按需读取材料并制定完整方案，PNG 交给生图模型绘制，SV: Generation workflow: the main model reads materials as needed and prepares a complete plan. An image model draws PNG figures; the main model writes SVG source for checking and rendering. Data figures and composite figures follow the selected output format.
视觉协作与检索优化：上传文件不改变自动、随机、手动或不检索的选择；有视觉能力的主: Vision and retrieval: uploads preserve automatic, random, manual or no-retrieval choices. A vision-capable main model can read images directly; with assistance, the visual model observes and the main model plans and decides. Unused roles are not called.
工作流性能优化：去除规划与风格阶段完全重复的上下文，复用普通模式中同一模型的视觉: Workflow performance: remove exact duplicate planning and styling context, and reuse the same model’s visual capabilities in basic mode to avoid redundant context transfer and role calls. Source material, numerical requirements and configured reviews are retained.
渠道路由优化：国内渠道与 Fireworks 从国内服务直连，OpenRoute: Provider routing: domestic providers and Fireworks use direct connections from the China service. OpenRouter, xAI, Novita and selected overseas providers use Hong Kong based on network measurements, while OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini retain Singapore routes. Model IDs, parameters and account settings are unchanged.
多候选与失败保护：逐张保存候选进度和已完成结果，修改失败保留上一张成功图及评审记: Candidate and failure handling: save each candidate’s progress and completed results. A failed revision retains the previous successful figure and its review. Uncertain calls are not blindly resubmitted, and historical tasks resume with their original workflow.
修复新加坡代理 DNS 解析导致部分连接绕远的问题，并调整 Fireworks: Fix proxy DNS resolution that sent some Singapore connections through a longer route, and adjust the Fireworks connection path. Route failures do not automatically replay potentially billable requests through another route.
分渠道线路与 DNS 优化发布: Provider routing and DNS optimization release
多任务管理：支持新建、重命名、置顶、搜索与快速切换，每项任务分别保存草稿、执行记: Multi-task management: create, rename, pin, search and switch tasks, each with its own drafts, execution history and candidate versions. Edit another task or prepare the next draft during generation; background results stay with their original task without changing the current view.
信息图类别大扩容：从 8 个粗分类升级为 13 大类、92 种具体图型，涵盖研究: Expanded figure taxonomy: the former 8 broad categories become 92 specific figure types across 13 groups, covering research mechanisms, process and control, system structures, statistical distributions, spatial fields, omics and model evaluation. Choices include forest plots, survival curves, volcano plots, genome circos plots and multi-panel figures.
图型检索与专属规范：支持中文、英文及别名搜索、分层浏览和放大预览，提供必要输入、: Figure discovery and specifications: search Chinese or English names and aliases, browse groups and enlarge previews. Each type explains required inputs, scope, easily confused alternatives and relevant variants, with 142 variant definitions in the catalog. Selected specifications inform planning and review.
论文参考图库更新：纳入 107 张逐图核验来源与使用许可的论文图，覆盖 89 种: Updated paper reference library: 107 figures with individually reviewed provenance and usage permissions cover 89 figure types; structural examples illustrate the remaining 3. Reference retrieval matches specific types, and previews show full figures, paper sources and license details.
评审流程优化：先生成实际图件，再检查当前画面；SVG 同时检查完整源码。每轮必要: Review workflow: generate the actual figure before reviewing its current image, with full source also reviewed for SVG. Each round can revise once and stop early on approval. A final-round revision does not add a hidden review and remains marked as unreviewed.
并发提交与后台执行保护：同一任务跨标签页提交时防止重复执行，已接收任务在切换页面: Concurrent-submission and background-execution safeguards: prevent duplicate runs when the same task is submitted across tabs, and resume progress checks for accepted jobs after navigation or refresh. Admission and queueing follow server capacity; limit errors are shown while drafts are preserved.
历史与草稿接续：分页载入账号历史任务，按需查看旧结果及执行记录；支持将此浏览器的: History and draft continuity: load account history in pages and open past results and execution records on demand. Import this browser’s guest drafts into the current account or export a local backup; save and sync failures preserve local content and offer retry.
原材料本地保存：原文件先保存在当前浏览器，提交时上传任务临时副本；任务结束后清理: Local original-file storage: save originals in the current browser and upload temporary copies when submitting a task. Temporary materials are cleaned up when the task ends, while results and read records remain. Missing originals can be reattached with file verification on another device without automatically starting generation.
材料来源追溯：读取记录标明文件、页码、工作表或行范围，区分已读、未读及部分读取；: Material provenance: read records identify files, pages, sheets or line ranges and distinguish complete, partial and unread coverage. Material conclusions can link to actual read locations; page images are observed in batches when they exceed a model’s per-request capacity, with coverage recorded.
期刊书架：以 18 本期刊的封面、简介和出版社信息组织规则，支持刊名、简称与出版: Journal bookshelf: browse 18 journals with covers, introductions and publisher information. Search or filter by name, abbreviation and publisher, open official journal, submission and rule-source links, and retain separate scroll positions in the shelf and reader.
期刊设置随任务保存规则版本，历史任务继续使用原快照；检查实际文件的尺寸、像素、格: Journal settings retain their rule version with each task. Inspect actual file dimensions, pixel counts, formats and other properties, and download a report. The new workspace exports original formats; the retained legacy workbench also converts PNG to white-background TIFF without adding pixels or inventing detail.
期刊规则参与生成与精修：按投稿阶段、图件用途和操作类型判断适用要求，明确禁止的: Journal rules inform generation and refinement by submission stage, figure purpose and operation. Explicitly prohibited AI uses and alteration of primary research images are blocked; conflicts, conditional permissions and unknowns remain visible. A rule check does not grant submission approval.
SVG 结果可直接编辑文字、字体、颜色、填充、描边、透明度及渐变色标，支持拖动、: Edit SVG text, fonts, colors, fills, strokes, opacity and gradient stops directly. Move, scale proportionally, rotate, group, align and distribute objects, with undo and redo. Text and shapes remain editable elements.
SVG 对象与图层：可添加文字、基础形状、连线和箭头，复制或删除对象；图层列表支: SVG objects and layers: add text, basic shapes, lines and arrows; duplicate or delete objects. Select, hide, lock and reorder layers, and use marquee selection, alignment snapping and saved guides for precise layouts.
SVG 曲线编辑：支持可编辑路径的节点与贝塞尔控制柄拖动、增删节点，以及椭圆弧的: SVG curve editing: move nodes and Bézier handles, add or remove nodes on supported paths, and adjust elliptical-arc radii, direction, large-arc selection and rotation. Complex or protected structures show their editing limits to avoid silently damaging the source.
模型连接统一管理：渠道连接可关联多个精确型号，密钥可选择仅保存在当前浏览器或在服: Unified model connections: associate multiple exact model IDs with one provider connection. Keep credentials in the current browser or encrypt them on the server for the account; changing storage scope never copies credentials automatically. Professional mode selects saved connections by the roles actually used.
模型规格卡片：展示输入／输出模态、上下文与输出上限、生图或编辑提示词限制及官方来: Model specification cards show input/output modalities, context and output limits, image-generation or editing prompt limits, and official sources. Distinguish provider specifications, manufacturer references, resolved service versions and unknowns, keeping characters, bytes and tokens in their original units.
评审证据绑定当前版本：同时核对实际成图、相关原材料与 SVG 源码，定量图件增加: Bind review evidence to the current version: compare the actual figure with relevant source materials and SVG code. Quantitative figures require records checking source values, units, scales and visual encoding; missing checks or unresolved issues cannot pass. Scientific conclusions still require human review.
辅助视觉问题逐项处理：主模型须对观察到的问题给出接受、驳回或未解决的结论与依据；: Resolve auxiliary visual findings individually: the main model must accept, reject or leave each issue unresolved with supporting evidence. Declared SVG arrow markers also undergo a local visibility check; findings or insufficient coverage prevent an unqualified model pass.
自动修订保留完整新方案：已确认支持参考图生成的图像接口会同时接收上一张候选图；其: Automatic revisions preserve the complete updated plan. Image endpoints confirmed to support reference-image generation also receive the previous candidate; other endpoints explicitly redraw from text using the selected model. Avoid redundant upscaling when native output meets the target resolution; reference-guided redrawing does not lock pixels.
精修逐项核对修改要求：将原图、当前修改指令、遮罩、辅助图用途和结构化约束带入规划: Check refinement requirements individually: planning and review receive the source image, current instructions, mask, reference purposes and structured constraints, and compare before/after images. Missing checks, unsupported conclusions or unresolved uncertainty cannot pass; full generation stops before drawing if no valid style plan is available.
模型目录扩展：相较 3.8.1，静态渠道型号身份从 1,040 条增至 1,10: Expanded model catalog: static provider/model identities grow from 1,040 in 3.8.1 to 1,103, alongside OpenRouter dynamic discovery. Add models and exact-provider adapters, including the latest DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 entries across three providers and Together Beam. Catalog inclusion does not establish account access.
动态目录与故障恢复：公开渠道目录支持分页刷新，读取未完成或失败时保留上次完整结果: Dynamic catalogs and recovery: refresh public provider catalogs with pagination, retain the last complete result when loading is incomplete or fails, and show provider errors. The legacy professional configuration also reads account catalogs using the selected provider’s credentials. Discovery alone does not enable unsupported models.
新站账号与授权回跳：国内站接入观猹登录，TokenDance 授权按发起站点返回: Account access and authorization callbacks on the new site: use Watcha sign-in on the China site and return TokenDance authorization to the originating site. Sign-in, verification emails and password-reset links use the appropriate entry while retaining existing account links and authorization.
帮助教程按新版工作区重写：说明任务与格式分支、快速／完整流程、候选与评审轮数、精: Rewritten workspace guide: explain tasks and format branches, quick/full workflows, candidates and review rounds, refinement, material storage and recovery. Actual calls and costs depend on reading, observation, review and revision, rather than candidate count alone.
修复长时间打开页面后正常会话轮询被错误累积限流的问题，减少账号、模型目录和历史结: Fix normal session polling being incorrectly accumulated into rate limits on long-open pages, reducing related account, catalog and history-loading failures while continuing to validate the live session.
补齐精确渠道适配：修正 TokenDance 部分文本与思考字段、fal 生成／: Correct exact-provider adapters for selected TokenDance text/thinking fields, fal generation/editing endpoints and Replicate text results. Fix video models misclassified as image generators and selected image-size/reference-input validation errors while retaining historical model records.
生成画布展示实际已产出的过程图，阶段记录可展开查看规划、设计和评审正文及耗时；执: The generation canvas shows real intermediate figures. Expand planning, design and review text with recorded timings; execution details show candidate states, failure reasons, selected references, requested models and provider-reported models without shrinking the canvas.
国内入口与原站保持同版工作台，国内业务及素材服务迁至杭州；改善静态资源传输、模板: The China and original sites share the same workspace version, with the China application and material services moved to Hangzhou. Improve static delivery, template previews, homepage responsiveness and background catalog loading while preserving accounts, tasks, results and the original entry.
完善原文件保存、刷新恢复与任务临时副本清理；保存或恢复完成前阻止提交，原件缺失时: Improve original-file saving, refresh recovery and temporary-material cleanup. Block submission until saving or recovery completes and report missing originals clearly. Material parsing and local SVG rendering errors show specific causes instead of reporting a known model response as an unknown outcome.
国内素材与存储迁移验收: China material and storage migration verification
新版任务式 UI 支持多任务管理、连续创作与后台进度，信息图扩展至 13 大类、: The task-based workspace adds multitasking, continuous creation and background progress, with 13 figure groups and 92 figure types. Updates cover PNG/SVG generation and review, journal rules, model routing, an account image library, mobile input, and synchronized Skill/MCP knowledge with offline support.
SVG 空白画布与自动保存：无需先调用模型即可手工绘图，支持缩放、平移和聚焦所选: The blank SVG canvas supports drawing without a model call, with zoom, pan and focus on selected objects. Manual edits autosave to the original task and sync with the account, ready to resume when reopened. Original images and previous versions are retained; legacy browser backups can be restored within an exactly matching task.
候选方案与连续创作：候选分别保存并支持并排比较，可切换当前候选或历史版本，在同一: Candidates are saved separately and can be compared side by side. Select a candidate or historical version and continue revising it in the same composer; each round is added to the original task history. PNG, original SVG and manual edits retain their version relationships, with individual downloads and task archive export.
账户设置按个人资料、账户、存储与语言分组，手机支持分类与子页返回；支持头像上传与: Settings are organized into profile, account, storage and language sections, with category navigation and a back action on mobile. They support avatar uploads and reset, login email changes verified through both addresses, a drawing activity heatmap, daily, weekly and cumulative totals, and streaks.
任务支持确认后彻底删除，清理任务草稿、执行记录、结果引用及关联恢复副本；独立账号: Permanently delete a task after confirmation, including its drafts, runs, result references and associated recovery copies. Saved images in the independent account image library and shared files are retained. Active tasks cannot be deleted; downloads and external backups are unaffected.
明确快速／完整生成流程：快速生成完成材料理解、规划、绘制与评审，完整生成增加风格: Quick generation includes material understanding, planning, drawing and review; the full workflow also develops a style plan. Up to 6 candidates and 5 review rounds are supported. New tasks default to one candidate in both basic and professional modes, preserving saved candidate choices. Candidate count does not mean concurrency.
修复手机键盘遮挡输入框、文字与光标位置偏移，以及长文本裁切或失焦后异常收起；键盘: Fix mobile keyboards covering the composer, text and caret misalignment, and long drafts being clipped or unexpectedly collapsed after blur. The welcome area retracts while the keyboard is open; long drafts remain multiline, wrap and scroll inside the input. Layout also recovers after closing the keyboard or returning from model/settings dialogs.
新增“提示词建议”，按绘图目标、元素、关系、布局、视觉与内容约束整理输入，并提供: Prompt guidance organizes requests by drawing goal, elements, relationships, layout, visual style and content constraints, with PNG/SVG and revision examples. Opening the guide preserves drafts and settings without calling a model.
账号图片库集中管理已保存的 PNG／SVG 结果，支持预览、下载和返回来源任务；: The account image library brings saved PNG/SVG results together for preview, download and navigation to their source tasks. Images remain independently accessible after a source task is deleted; storage use and cumulative drawing statistics are shown separately.
图片保存规则明确为每账号 100 MB、首次保存后 30 天；相同内容去重计量，: Image storage is limited to 100 MB per account and 30 days from first save. Identical content counts once; expired images are removed automatically and the oldest eligible images are reclaimed when space is needed. Historical images with unreliable save times or already expired during migration are temporarily protected. Missing originals are reported explicitly, without claiming recovery.
智能体接入同步 Tuyan Skill／MCP 知识 1.2.1：覆盖 13 大: Agent integration now uses Tuyan Skill/MCP knowledge 1.2.1, covering 13 figure groups, 92 figure types and rules for 18 journals. Required inputs, variants, submission stages, official sources, verification dates and historical rule versions are retained. Anonymous MCP provides read-only knowledge and does not accept papers, images, prompts or credentials.
智能体工作流补齐输入证据与缺失数据检查、图型选择、多面板语义及能力不足时的方案交: Agent workflows add source-evidence and missing-data checks, figure-type selection, multipanel semantics, and specification delivery when rendering capabilities are unavailable. PNG review checks the rendered image; SVG review checks both source and rendering. Reviews are tied to the actual artifact version, with numerical checks recorded separately from visual evaluation.
首页模板改为紧凑卡片轮播，支持鼠标拖动、手机滑动与轻点预览，拖动不会误开预览；欢: The home page uses a compact template carousel with mouse dragging, touch swiping and tap-to-preview, without opening previews during a drag. Welcome messages animate letter by letter, stop when typing begins and respect reduced-motion preferences.
渠道连接与型号选择统一品牌图标，配置弹窗在桌面采用双列、手机采用单列；表单滚动与: Provider connections and model selectors use consistent brand icons. Configuration dialogs use two columns on desktop and one on mobile, separating the scrolling form from action buttons. Dropdowns support keyboard selection without clipping; canceling preserves the saved configuration.
工作台统一要求登录后使用，会话失效时引导重新登录并保留本机草稿；同一账号超出同时: The workbench requires sign-in. Expired sessions prompt users to sign in again while preserving local drafts. Tasks beyond an account’s active-run allowance enter a bounded queue, busy accounts do not block other accounts, and a full queue is reported explicitly.
Skill、MCP 独立仓库与离线包同步同一知识内容，离线包包含运行所需知识与依: The standalone Skill and MCP repositories and offline package share the same knowledge content. The offline package includes its required knowledge and dependencies, preserves legacy-format reading, and adds English summaries and checklists with explicit language and source labels for original rules.
完善 PNG 生成与精修评审的格式约束和当前图像版本绑定；无效评审仍保留已生成图: Strengthen the response format and current-image version binding for PNG generation and refinement reviews. Invalid reviews retain the generated image and report an incomplete review, without converting it to a pass or adding hidden retries.
修复国内 Skill 下载入口返回网页而非安装文件，以及知识版本记录与本轮实际来: Fix the domestic Skill download endpoint returning a web page instead of installation files, and knowledge provenance not matching the source used for the current run. Download manifests include file checksums, and SVG source and rendering checks apply regardless of filename extension case.
